about_the_game:
Build a protected village for your orc heroine to live in with the KR Tribal Fort Tileset! Kokoro Reflections is here with a MV/MZ-sized tileset ready to help you build wooden huts and thick log walls to keep the village safe from deadly monsters and dangerous adventurers! A1, A2, A3, A4, A5, and 5 B sheets are ready to build exteriors and interiors filled with all the spikes, skulls, and weaponry an orc could wish for. Create buildings with wooden logs tied together with ropes and decorated with bones, and mark the chief’s home with draped red cloth off its roof. Create arenas for the villagers to train in with curved walls of logs, or mark combat areas with large curved bone and set up an armory hut filled with gnarly weapons nearby so fights are always fair. Let your heroes recover in rooms with roughly hammered together shelves and beds made from animal hides, and lock troublemakers up in wooden cages!

This pack also includes character sprites for log gates, a wooden treasure chest, a cloth curtain to use as a door, and rotating meat that you can set up over a campfire. Reward your players patience by having the raw meat they stick over the fire turn into a stat-boosting roasted meal, and stop your players from leaving the village too early by keeping the massive wooden gates firmly closed until they’re properly equipped. If your orc heroine needs a strong place to call home, or you want to give your adventurers a new place to challenge orcs and goblins, pick up the KR Tribal Fort Tileset!


The Tribal Fort Includes:

Ground tiles:

* water
* grass
* dirt
* woven rope texture
* short autotile fence
* rocks and thorns
* high grass
* and an autotile hide rug

Walls/roofs:

* Wide variety of log walls, with variations in rope trim, spikes, bones, window openings, and more! Also includes rope texture wall and stone!

Also includes:

* Stairs to match ground
* Many variations of logs, with different widths and lengths, broken and whole, includes fallen versions
* Curved fence sections and rounded house exterior
* Lots of rope, skull and ripped fabric details. Includes very large ribs, plus fangs and spikes you can use to decorate the edges of buildings.
* Bridges with bone details
* Various windows with lit/unlit versions
* Fire pits and braziers, including a version you can hang from the side of a building
* Trees and bushes
* Well with rustic buckets
* Scattered rocks, large stones and gravestones
* Drying racks for hides and fish
* Totem designs
* Rounded roof with rib bones and red fabric
* Diagonal stairs, climbing rope, ladder, etc
* Shelves with layerable items - add them any way you like them!
* Weapons and weapon racks, shields, plus broken versions
* Fireplace
* Beds
* Stamp to turn square floors into rounded ones

Events and Animations:

* Moving curtains
* Fire
* Small gate
* Fancy gate
* Meat roasting over fire
* Rustic treasure chest

MZ/MV Samplemap included!


Terms of Use:

This pack is for use in RPG Maker Series or the engine of your choice.
OK to be used in Commercial projects
Contents can be edited
OK for use in games with gore
OK for use in adult-rated games

short_description: Don't leave your orcs, barbarians and other tribal characters out in the rain! The Tribal Fort tileset comes with spike-topped fences, huts, and just enough skull-covered decorations to remind the neighbors who the real warriors are.
